note: Which guideline folders each specialty agent searches, Indian sources first, and a short reporting checklist per protocol (element names with the verbatim line and page of the source). Reference only, never a recommendation for this patient: agents use a checklist to note which reporting elements the Case File records do not document, never to interpret images, stage, diagnose or recommend treatment. Built for V1 item 5.5; PM-JAY oncology STGs are not on disk yet (pmjay holds HBP 2.2 pre-authorization rules).

radiology.checklist_note: From the ICRI / IRIA onco-imaging reporting checklists (India). The NCG-KCDO radiology synoptic template has rectal and colon templates but none for lung or breast. Oral cavity: the radiology synoptic reporting format of the NCG head and neck guideline (Annexure 1, India). Cervix: the ICRI / IRIA carcinoma cervix reporting format (CECT, the pelvis items also for MRI; the NCG gynaecological guideline has no radiology template).

pathology.checklist_note: Oral cavity: the NCG head and neck pathology synoptic format (Annexure 2, India; core items only). Other cancers: Indian sources (NCG, ICMR, TMC) define no pathology reporting dataset, so the checklists come from the international CAP protocols (resection specimens). Cervix: none (no CAP, ICCR or RCPath cervix dataset on disk; NCG lists only tumour type, grade, depth of invasion and LVSI, which the Pre-Authorization already checks).
